reasoning_traces.think:
The agent operating spine integrates modular components—agents, tasks, workflows, and cockpit maps—into a unified decision-making framework. Each module contributes to a structured state transition system where agents execute tasks within workflows, guided by cockpit maps. The projection feature registry enables feature-based decision synthesis, while the cockpit map defines operational boundaries. These primitives form a dual structure: one for probabilistic reasoning (GSI) and another for situational awareness (GSE). Failure modes arise when agent-task misalignment occurs or when cockpit constraints become outdated. The system exhibits robustness through layered feedback loops and empirical telemetry validation.
